views.title: East court: beds, jasmine trellis and stepping route from the dirty kitchen
caption_notes: Level east-court view from the dirty kitchen, 24 mm and 1.35 m eye above its floor. The legacy above-view identifier is retained only for delivery continuity. Part-shade planting, complete star-jasmine trellis and living stepping approach form one court; the foreground dining approach is secondary and may be cropped by the frame. The closer window standing point clears the kitchen counter and retains the original three required planting sightlines. Young authored planting ASSUMED; nursery, roots, drainage and photographic likeness UNVERIFIED. All original planting groups remain framing subjects. Open-court candidates that framed this context came within 1 m of fixed door planting; supported roof alternatives met crop, foliage-proximity or foreground-frame constraints. No design content moved.

Client/lead decisions 2026-10-06. Procedural botanical and furniture appearances ASSUMED look-alike proxies; photographic likeness, procurement and Egypt nursery performance UNVERIFIED. Bowl is the client-approved no-pots exception. Pergola dimensions and climber cover ASSUMED; structural footings, both beam cantilevers, roots and drainage UNVERIFIED.
